detail: Full summary: The real-data check caught a defect the synthetic unit tests missed: the alternatives term returned 0 rather than null for index projections, silently zeroing 25 percent of the rubric weight on every historical record. The fixtures did not catch it because I had written them to match my own assumption. Running a new scorer against real recorded data before trusting it is worth the ten minutes.
